claims.text: The CNN model achieved the highest macro-F1 score of 0.80 in discriminating between offensive and non-offensive posts, outperforming the RNN model.
In all three sub-tasks, the CNN-based sentence classifier achieved the best results compared to other models.
The CNN system outperformed the BiLSTM model with a macro-F1 score of 0.69 in identifying insults and threats.
